name: selected_route_id
description: Id for selected_route. Logical primary key. Format: ^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$, length 4-63.

name: display_name
description: User provided name for the route. Non-unique; for human readability in reports.

name: speed_reading_intervals
description: Intervals representing the road density across the route. Query using LEFT JOIN UNNEST to avoid row dropping.

fields.name: interval_coordinates
fields.description: The coordinates on the polyline for the speed reading interval.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude coordinate of a coordinate within speed reading interval.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude coordinate of a coordinate within speed reading interval.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: Describes the categorized current speed of road conditions. Possible values: NORMAL, SLOW, TRAFFIC_JAM.

fields.name: duration_in_seconds
fields.description: The duration of travel through the route based on current road conditions. Bounded >= 0.0.

fields.name: static_duration_in_seconds
fields.description: The duration of travel through the route without taking road conditions into consideration. Bounded > 0.0.

name: retrieval_time
description: The time the road data was collected, represented as a custom Timestamp.

fields.name: seconds
fields.description: Represents seconds of UTC time since Unix epoch.

fields.name: nanos
fields.description: Non-negative fractions of a second at nanosecond resolution.

name: route_geometry
description: Contains a geojson polyline representing the optimal route determined based on user's input waypoints.

name: road_segment_ids
description: Place IDs along the route in topological order indicating connected road segments.

name: subscription_name
description: Pub/Sub subscription metadata: Name of the subscription that delivered the message.

name: message_id
description: Pub/Sub subscription metadata: Unique identifier of the delivered message, useful for deduplication.

name: publish_time
description: Pub/Sub subscription metadata: UTC timestamp representing when the message was published to the topic. Highly recommended as a BigQuery partitioning column.

name: attributes
description: Pub/Sub subscription metadata: JSON-formatted string of any user-defined message attributes.
